ops.title: hermes-image-builder lost KVM: nested build falls back to TCG
ops.description: bootstrap2 run 2026-07-07: hermes nixos.img build logged 'Could not access KVM kernel module: Permission denied' and fell back to TCG (slow). Prior sessions had the nested-KVM builder confirmed working. Find what regressed (entitlements/permissions on the builder VM or qemu invocation) and restore KVM acceleration.

ops.text: a hermes image build logs KVM acceleration active (no TCG fallback) and completes in the previously-normal time
